name: Pet Store Tycoon
desc:
🐾 Welcome to Pet Store Tycoon!

Small shop. Big dreams. Lots of adorable pets! Build your dream pet store and keep your pets happy! Team up with friends to run a store together!

How to Play:
🐹 Feed, clean, and play with your pets
📦 Stock your shelves and serve customers
🔓 Unlock new animals and expand your store
🎨 Decorate your shop and make it your own

👍 Like the game and join the group!

💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Console, and Tablet
